_manifest.components: Deployed Mainnet protocol contracts (15); with the 3 project Gnosis Safes they form the 18 documented on-chain components. This is a list of deployed components, not a claim that every component is active. CommitmentVault (V1) stays listed as the legacy vault: existing tranches unlock through V1 only, and new locks go to CommitmentVaultV2 (TIME_ONLY). Legacy BootstrapVault V1 is deprecated and listed only in docs/DEPLOYMENTS.md.
_manifest.unknownPolicy: deployer, tx and timestamp are null when no deployment record exists in this repository; they are unknown, not omitted by accident. Fill them only from a verified deployment transaction.
_manifest.abiDirectory: abi/ (only BuilderRegistry, BuybackController, CommitmentVault (shared by V1 and V2), LendingVault have committed ABIs)
